summary: Test-only change: six integration tests for can_read/can_write. Mutants must target src/lib.rs, which the diff does not touch.

defects.description: No test ever expects can_read to return false (e.g. a member outside the owner and group on a private document), so replacing can_read with `true` survives. This is a permission check, so the gap is high risk.

The fixtures give the user id 1, group 1, and the document owner 1, group 1, so the owner and group-member tests cannot tell which rule granted access; `group_member_can_read` is identical to `owner_can_read`. Mutating `||` to `&&` between the owner and group checks, or `user.group_id == doc.group_id` to compare the wrong field, survives. Fixtures need distinct ids (owner-only user, group-only user).
No test checks that a non-owner Member is denied write; mutating `user.role == Role::Admin` to `!=` in can_write survives because the only Member fixture is also the owner.
